key_idea: Encoding hypothetical excess derivative growth as an invariant probability measure on conformal maps, and deriving a contradiction by topologically pairing saddles and maxima of a target potential to restrict the expected Jacobian.
reason: This argument tackles a notoriously difficult analytic bound with an extraordinarily creative cross-field strategy. It recasts a purely function-theoretic problem into ergodic theory and Morse topology, producing a deep conceptual contradiction with a pristine logical structure and virtually no brute-force computation.
